name: Dal Tadka with Steamed Basmati Rice
instructions: Boil toor dal with turmeric and salt until tender. In a pan, temper ghee with onions and tomatoes. Combine with cooked dal and serve over steamed basmati rice.

name: Paneer Bhurji with Whole Wheat Roti
instructions: Crumble paneer. Sauté onions and tomatoes in ghee with spices. Add crumbled paneer and toss for 3 minutes. Serve hot with fresh atta rotis.

name: High-Protein Chana Masala
instructions: Simmer boiled chickpeas in a spicy onion-tomato gravy with sautéed spinach. Serve as a nutrient-dense vegan meal.

name: Homestyle Egg Curry with Basmati Rice
instructions: Boil and lightly sear whole eggs. Sauté onions, garlic, and tomatoes into a rich masala gravy. Simmer eggs in curry and serve with basmati rice.

name: Tandoori-Spiced Chicken Tikka Bowl
instructions: Marinate diced chicken breast in spices and lemon. Pan-sear or grill until charred. Serve with basmati rice and sautéed peppers and onions.

name: High-Protein Whole Wheat Bolognese
instructions: Brown lean ground beef with onion in olive oil. Add crushed tomatoes and simmer for 25 minutes. Toss with cooked whole wheat pasta.

name: Chicken & Broccoli Penne with Parmesan
instructions: Sauté diced chicken breast and broccoli in olive oil. Toss with al dente whole wheat penne and finish with freshly grated parmesan cheese.

name: Mediterranean Tuna & Pasta Salad
instructions: Boil whole wheat pasta and rinse in cool water. Toss with drained canned tuna, diced tomatoes, crisp bell peppers, and extra virgin olive oil.

ingredients.ingredient_name: Cooked whole wheat pasta dry basis

name: Ricotta & Spinach Stuffed Chicken Breast
instructions: Cut a pocket in chicken breast. Stuff with part-skim ricotta, wilted spinach, and parmesan. Sear in olive oil and bake until cooked through.

name: Turkey Meatballs with Whole Wheat Spaghetti
instructions: Form ground turkey into meatballs. Brown in olive oil, then simmer in tomato sauce. Serve over whole wheat pasta.

name: High-Protein Chicken Burrito Bowl
instructions: Grill seasoned chicken breast. Assemble in a bowl with cooked brown rice, black beans, diced bell peppers, and a drizzle of olive oil.

name: Lean Beef & Black Bean Fajita Bowl
instructions: Sear lean ground beef with sliced onions and bell peppers in olive oil. Serve over warm black beans with Mexican seasonings.

name: Turkey & Black Bean Taco Salad
instructions: Sauté ground turkey with taco spices. Mix with black beans, diced tomatoes, fresh bell peppers, and olive oil.

name: Black Bean & Egg White Breakfast Quesadilla
instructions: Scramble egg whites with bell peppers. Layer inside warm corn tortillas with black beans and toast on skillet until crispy.

name: Chipotle Grilled Shrimp & Brown Rice Bowl
instructions: Pan-sear shrimp with chipotle spices in olive oil. Serve over warm brown rice with black beans and diced peppers.

name: Classic Grilled Chicken with Sweet Potato & Broccoli
instructions: Season chicken breast and grill. Roast cubed sweet potato and steam broccoli florets. Serve drizzled with olive oil.

name: Salmon Teriyaki with Brown Rice & Asparagus
instructions: Pan-sear salmon fillet with soy sauce tamari. Steam fresh asparagus spears and serve alongside cooked brown rice.

name: Tofu & Veggie Stir-Fry with Quinoa
instructions: Press and cube firm tofu. Stir-fry with broccoli and bell peppers in soy sauce tamari. Serve over cooked protein-rich quinoa.

name: Lean Beef & Broccoli Stir-Fry with Brown Rice
instructions: Stir-fry lean ground beef and broccoli florets in olive oil and tamari soy sauce. Serve hot over steamed brown rice.

name: Post-Workout Greek Yogurt Oatmeal Power Bowl
instructions: Cook rolled oats in water. Top with thick Greek yogurt, sliced banana, fresh blueberries, chia seeds, and optional text-only garnish.

name: Egg Bhurji with Atta Roti
instructions: Knead atta with water and roll thin rotis; cook on a hot tawa. Saute onion and tomato in oil, add beaten eggs with turmeric and chilli, and scramble until just set. Serve with the rotis.

name: Masala Oats with Egg Whites
instructions: Saute onion, tomato and spinach with spices, add oats and water and simmer until thick. Stir in egg whites and cook for two minutes until set.

name: Peanut Butter Banana Toast
instructions: Toast the bread, spread with peanut butter and top with sliced banana.

name: Masoor Dal with Atta Roti
instructions: Pressure-cook masoor dal with turmeric until soft. Temper ghee with cumin, onion and tomato and stir into the dal. Serve with hot atta rotis.

name: Chana Aloo Curry with Rice
instructions: Cook onion and tomato in oil with chana masala spices, add boiled chickpeas and diced potato with water and simmer until the potato is tender. Serve over steamed rice.

name: Toor Dal Khichdi with Spinach
instructions: Pressure-cook rice with water, then mix in cooked toor dal and chopped spinach and simmer. Finish with a ghee and onion tadka.

name: Egg & Potato Curry with Atta Roti
instructions: Hard-boil the eggs. Cook onion and tomato masala in oil, add diced potato and water and simmer until tender, then add the halved eggs. Serve with atta rotis.

name: Palak Masoor Dal with Brown Rice
instructions: Cook masoor dal until soft, add chopped spinach and simmer. Temper with ghee, onion and tomato. Serve over brown rice.

name: Chana Chaat
instructions: Toss boiled chickpeas with chopped onion, tomato and grated carrot, chaat masala, lemon juice and salt.

name: Boiled Eggs with Masala Sweet Potato
instructions: Boil the eggs and the sweet potato. Cube the sweet potato and toss with onion, chaat masala and salt; serve with the halved eggs.

name: Tofu Bhurji with Atta Roti
instructions: Crumble firm tofu. Saute onion, tomato and spinach in oil with turmeric and chilli, add the tofu and cook for five minutes. Serve with atta rotis.

name: Dahi Oats Bowl with Almonds
instructions: Stir rolled oats into thick dahi (strained yogurt) and rest for ten minutes. Top with sliced banana and chopped almonds.

name: Quinoa Vegetable Upma with Paneer
instructions: Rinse and cook quinoa. Saute onion and carrot in ghee with mustard seeds and curry leaves, add the quinoa and cubed paneer and toss until hot.

name: Palak Paneer with Brown Rice
instructions: Blanch and puree spinach. Cook onion and tomato in ghee with garam masala, add the spinach puree and paneer cubes and simmer. Serve with brown rice.

name: Paneer Tikka with Peppers
instructions: Marinate paneer, bell pepper and onion in thick dahi with tikka spices. Thread on skewers and grill or pan-roast with a little oil until charred.

name: Chana Paneer Salad
instructions: Toss boiled chana with paneer cubes, tomato, onion and bell pepper, chaat masala, lemon juice and salt.
